name: NBA Q4 state model taker
description: Taker on NBA game-winner markets at Q4 stoppages (300/180/120/60 s left): a gradient-boosted win-probability model (score diff, seconds left, ESPN pregame spread, possession, pace; trained on 2017-2024 seasons of ESPN play-by-play) is compared with the Kalshi ask/bid; buy YES or NO when model edge after fee is >= 2c. Research only: needs a live play-by-play feed, so the engine pipeline can't run it.
hypothesis: Kalshi NBA winner prices underuse the state (lead, time, possession, pace, spread) at late-Q4 stoppages; a state model trained on 8 seasons of play-by-play finds mispricings of 2c+ after fees. Wrong if realized c/contract on games not used to pick the rule has a CI that includes 0.
next: Full 2/3 inconclusive (edge>=4c): +3.18c CI +0.03..+6.65, 581 mkts, 6/9 months positive (Feb, Mar negative). One full test left; needs live PBP feed + forward 2026-27 data before more tests.
